name: Iroha
source:
The boy that Mikoto met at the hospital. He's extremely popular among the students, and the strongest member of the Brights. He has a reputation for being perfect, and normally shows very little emotion.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/01/13/review-hana-awase-mizuchi-chapter/]otome-jikan[/url]]
